title: ICIG hinted to Brown that humans are not in charge
summary: Matthew Brown tells of ICIG hinted to Brown that humans are not in charge, about recent at Intelligence Community Inspector General, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the ICIG did it >> with me personally I I want to respect them but the ICI did it with me yes

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about his dealings with the Intelligence Community Inspector General, the official watchdog that investigates wrongdoing inside US spy agencies. Brown says that office hinted to him personally that humans are not the ones in charge, adding that he wants to be respectful toward them but that they did it. If true, it would mean people inside the government's own oversight system are signalling that some other intelligence holds power.
